hero.title: Future Knowledge Creation Initiative
hero.subtitle: Join EduBridge in Empowering Underprivileged Children. The EduBridge program creates conditions for children with opportunities for quality education. We have supported more than 13 provinces across the North with many meaningful activities.

about.title: About the Program
about.description1: The Future Knowledge Creation Initiative is a charity program by EDU BRIDGE aimed at bringing opportunities to students with difficult circumstances across Vietnam.
about.description2: We increase the value of education as the key to changing their lives and future. Through this program, we are committed to:

libraries.title: Build 05 LIBRARIES
libraries.description: Provide free books and materials for remote areas, villages, and difficult-to-access schools

scholarships.title: 10,000 Scholarships
scholarships.description: 1,000 ONLINE SCHOLARSHIPS for English courses. Organize up to 20 free STEM workshops

courses.title: 1,000 Online Courses
courses.description: Provide online English courses to help students improve their language skills

workshops.title: 20 STEM Workshops
workshops.description: Organize free STEM workshops for students to develop practical skills

training.title: Teacher Training
training.description: Enhance work skills and soft skills for local teachers
